arjun_sales: Quick thread 9: FinEdge wants a short pilot. Requirements: SSE streaming for event scoring, deterministic JSON output per schema, function-calls to trigger their webhook, and 'offline KMS' noted in their security questionnaire. They also want a tiny sample repo.

maya_se: Copy. Primary devs are Python. Ops uses k8s. Is full air-gapped KMS an absolute?

arjun_sales: They wrote: "offline HSM, no network egress"  — sounds like air-gap.

sam_runtime: Air-gapped = Private/on-prem. For pilot we should propose Hosted+VPC with BYOK (customer-managed KMS) and compensating controls. Technical samples: I can deliver a Python streaming + function-call example and a curl SSE snippet.

maya_se: Minimal Python snippet (pseudo):
```py
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
stream = cli.responses.stream({ 'model': 'redwood-infer-2', 'input': 'score event', 'schema': { 'type':'object','properties':{'alert':{'type':'object'}}}, 'functions':[{'name':'create_alert','parameters':{'type':'object','properties':{'id':{'type':'string'},'score':{'type':'number'}}}}] })
for chunk in stream:
  if chunk.get('type') == 'function_call':
    requests.post('https://finedge/webhook', json=chunk['arguments'])
  else:
    print(chunk.get('delta'))
```

arjun_sales: Good. Also need a curl SSE example and a README that explains schema enforcement vs client-side validation.

tess_prod: Capacity note: Hosted+BYOK can be provisioned quickly; Dedicated/Private adds lead time and cost. Pilot discounts: standard 30% for 60-90d. SalesOps can approve up to 40% for strategic.

raquel_legal: We do not transfer product IP. We'll provide SOC2 under NDA. Offline KMS = on-prem Private deployment; estimate 6-10 weeks. Recommend we offer Hosted+BYOK + SOC2 + architecture diagram first.

sec-bot: SOC2 report available: redwood-soc2-2025 (NDA).

arjun_sales: Actions: Maya assemble Python+curl+README and push private repo link. Sam create quickstart Dockerfile. Tess prepare pilot pricing and capacity estimate. Raquel draft SOW language refusing IP assignment and DPA + NDA links. I'll send the bundle and propose Hosted+BYOK + 30% pilot discount.

maya_se: Will upload examples and README EOD PT.

arjun_sales: Please update this thread with any pushback from FinEdge. :thumbsup:
